Complete [[Arborstone]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Retrieve the [[Urn of Saint Viktor]] from the cathedral in [[Arborstone (outpost)|Arborstone]].
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in under 30 minutes.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,000 [[Gold]]
* 2,500 [[Kurzick Faction]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 30 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 45 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per the [[Arborstone#Walkthrough|Arborstone]] mission.

==Dialogue==

===Initial dialogue===
;Zaishen Mission
:''"[[Master Togo]] seeks an artifact of [[Saint Viktor]]. Contact Brother [[Mhenlo]] and retrieve the sacred urn from the [[zu Heltzer]]s of Arborstone."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = The battle rages on! All able-bodied heroes should hasten to defend those bravely protecting [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]]. }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zehnchu
:''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

==Notes==
*This quest was first offered on June 1st, 2009.
